content: Open Science by AIPOCH is an open-source, cross-platform AI research workbench designed for macOS, Windows, and Linux. title: 多家银行集中「清淤」，工行核销超 800 亿元，背后原因是什么？释放出哪些信号？
content: In 2026, Chinese banks, led by ICBC, intensified non-performing loan write-offs, totaling over 80 billion yuan. This proactive cleanup addresses latent risks from previous consumer and real estate loan expansions, compounded by slow income recovery. Regulatory changes ending transitional periods forced accurate risk recognition. While robust loan loss reserves enabled this, retail sector pressures persist. Experts note that while write-offs free up regulatory capital, true asset quality improvement remains contingent on broader macroeconomic recovery and declining overdue loan trends.

title: 果蝇版黑客帝国来了：谷歌十年画出果蝇大脑，硕士生用GPT-6两天让它沙盒起飞
content: Georgia Tech student Evan Smith integrated the newly published MaleCNS v1.0 connectome of a male Drosophila into Minecraft. Utilizing GPT-6 Astra, he developed a simulator where 166,700 neurons drive the virtual fly’s behavior in a sandbox environment. This achievement, completed in two days, demonstrates that full-brain simulations are now accessible to individual developers using open-source data, AI assistance, and standard game engines, significantly lowering the barrier for neuroscience research.

title: AI科学家冲出屏幕！MIT教授扔4张照片，3个Grok一小时造出零件
content: MIT professor Markus Buehler employed three Grok AI bots to design and manufacture physical parts from four reference images. The AI agents autonomously wrote a physics simulator, executed 47 experiments, and drove a 3D printer via its graphical interface. This process produced two plastic components in under an hour, demonstrating that AI can now interact with physical hardware through existing software rather than specialized robotic interfaces, thereby significantly reducing the cost of automated experimentation.

title: OKF Agent Memory – Git-native persistent memory for AI coding agents
content: OKF Agent Memory is a Git-native tool designed to provide persistent memory for AI coding agents. By utilizing the Git version control system, it allows these agents to maintain and retrieve contextual information across different sessions and operations. This approach integrates memory storage directly into the development workflow, leveraging Git’s robust tracking and history features to ensure that AI assistants retain consistent project knowledge over time.

content: The U.S. Commerce Department announced that Secretary Howard Lutnick will review Pentagon contracts involving companies affiliated with the investment firm Cerberus Capital Management. This action aims to address potential conflicts of interest, following scrutiny of Cerberus's holdings in defense-related firms. The review will assess whether these transactions comply with federal procurement regulations and ensure the integrity of government defense spending. Lutnick's office will determine if any contracts require modification or termination to prevent improper influence on federal purchasing decisions.

content: In a dramatic upset, Zheng Qinwen advanced to the 2026 US Open Round of 16, securing her career-third appearance in this stage. After entering the main draw via the qualifying rounds and suffering a first-set loss, Zheng trailed 0-5 in the deciding set against 22nd seed Alison Riske. She staged a remarkable comeback, winning the next seven games and saving a match point to claim a 1-6, 7-6(3), 7-5 victory. This result marked her sixth consecutive win since the qualifiers and set up a next-round match against Iga Swiatek.
